hypothesis: Real options order-flow toxicity predicts subsequent realized volatility, and a signal-timed delta-hedged ATM straddle is net-of-cost tradable for the BTC/ETH perpetual on real, synchronized data.

protocol.title: Real options order-flow toxicity -> subsequent realized volatility, traded via a signal-timed delta-hedged ATM straddle net-of-cost on the BTC/ETH perpetual

tox_detail.tox: (call_notional - put_notional) / (call_notional + put_notional) from real Deribit option trades per bar

protocol.position: q_k = clip(expanding_z(tox_k), -1, 1); causal decision at bar k
protocol.realized_vol_target: rv_{k+1} = |log(S_{k+1}) - log(S_k)| from Deribit 1m perp candles
protocol.straddle: ATM straddle from real surface snapshot (newest 5m snapshot whose candle closed by bar_end = bar_ms + 300s); IV backed out of the real mark via implied_volatility(mark*spot, spot, K, 0, T, type); greeks from black_scholes_greeks at that IV
protocol.pnl_per_bar: q_k * [vega*(IV_{k+1}-IV_k) + 0.5*gamma*(dS)^2 - theta*dt] - cost_bps*|q_k*delta_k - q_{k-1}*delta_{k-1}|/1e4 - cost_bps*|q_k - q_{k-1}|/1e4
protocol.cost_model: net-of-cost: pre-registered 5 bps on delta-hedge rebalance and straddle-position turnover
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on both BTC and ETH and at least one grid config, net-of-cost Sharpe > 0, no kill-switch breach (max-DD <= 0.20), permutation p < 0.05, bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled PBO < 0.5; else NO-GO.
